senses.definition: n.m. Pr 1:14 bag, purse (perhaps kindred with כּוֹם, q.v.; Arabic كِيسٌ (prob. from Pers. كِيسَهْ Lane 2640); Ethiopic ኪስ; NH כִּיס; Aramaic כִּיסָא, ܟܻܝܣܳܐ; Palm. מן כיסה from his purse = at his own expense, Vog p. 13 al.)—bag, in which were carried:
weights (v. אֶבֶן 5) Dt 25:13; Mi 6:11; Pr 16:11;
money, i.e. a purse Is 46:6; Pr 1:14.
